description: Connector cards: a connected app's own UI in the chat, for any connector. One tool call per ask; the plugin reads and writes the app itself through Bonsai's sign-in, and Jev picks the connector, the view and the fields at runtime. Linear and Google Calendar today; a scaffold adds more.

skills.description: Show, draft, or change records of a connected app (Linear issues, Google Calendar events, more to come) through cards shaped like the app's own UI. One tool call with the person's words; the plugin reads the app and Jev picks the view. Use for 'what's open', 'show NEAT-9', 'what's on today', 'schedule a call', 'create a ticket', and the Save/Create/RSVP messages cards send.

skills.displayName: Add a connector to Connector cards
skills.description: The process for giving a new connected app (Slack, Gmail, Notion…) its own cards in the connector-cards plugin: inventory what Bonsai can reach, map the app's screens, scaffold the module, write the reads, rubrics, writes and compositions, build the eval set, test in fresh sessions. Use when asked to add a connector to connector cards or to make cards for an app.

tools.description: Show records from a connected app as that app's own UI. Pass the person's words; the plugin routes to the connector, reads it, and Jev picks the view, scope and fields.
Show one record (an issue, an event) as the app's own detail view with live controls.
Draft a new record as the app's own create dialog; Jev picks the properties, the person edits and confirms on the card.
Write what the person did on a card back to its app (Save, Create, Comment, RSVP), then redraw the card from the app's truth.

purposes: Read and write Linear issues to draw and apply the Linear cards.
Read and write Google Calendar events to draw and apply the calendar cards.
